summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing completed for Lunar Coins Tebex demo-mode store. All 6 backend API tests pass and all frontend flows (hero, coin grid, cart add/qty/remove, checkout demo toast, FAQ accordion, nav scrolling) work end-to-end.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: missing Description or aria-describedby. Non-blocking accessibility warning.

action_items: Optional: add SheetDescription (or aria-describedby) to CartDrawer's SheetContent to silence the a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/basket/add correctly raises HTTPException(400) in demo mode -> clean JSON response, not 5xx gateway. Good.
server.py demo_store fallback keeps store always usable when Tebex token invalid. Good.
CartDrawer startCheckout correctly detects demo mode by res.demo || !res.ident and shows German toast without redirect. Verified.

All required data-testid attributes present (coin-card-*, add-to-cart-*, cart-drawer, cart-item-*, qty-*, increase-*, decrease-*, remove-item-*, cart-total, checkout-button, confirm-link-button, faq-accordion, nav-shop, nav-vorteile, nav-faq, cart-trigger, brand-logo, hero-shop-cta).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth (public storefront, Tebex demo mode)
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is intentionally in DEMO MODE (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Real Tebex checkout redirect cannot be exercised without a valid Headless public token. All demo behavior verified: GET /api/store -> 6 demo packages (EUR), POST /api/basket/create -> {demo:true}, POST /api/basket/add -> HTTP 400 JSON 'Demo-Modus'. Frontend: cart flow shows Demo-Modus toast on confirm-link-button and does NOT redirect. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
